en.name: Fearmonger
en.ability: Each night, choose a player. If you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose a player. If you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.

zh.name: 恐惧之灵
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择一名玩家：如果你提名他且他被处决，他的阵营落败。当你首次选择或更换目标时，所有玩家都会得知你选择了新的玩家。
